verdicts.reason: A scales the type up and spreads it down the portrait canvas, which fits the format better. Its flaws: the CTA sits about 180px below the headline, so it drifts away from its group, and particle dots touch the end of 'Line' and sit next to the sun. B keeps the original's proportions but leaves the headline and CTA small. All its content is crowded into the upper 57%, leaving the bottom 40% as dead particle field, and a particle sits on the 'E' of SOLSTICE so the wordmark looks clipped.
